title: Hoshino Ichika — Be Careful Of Snatching!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a break here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I wanna keep going a bit longer!
I feel like I'm on fire today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, we need to stop. We've been really focused today, but the quality of our performance is only gonna start falling if we push any harder.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. As amazing as I feel on the drums today, the fatigue of playing may start creeping up on me if we continue.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's important to rest when we can, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right.
I guess we have to be careful not to get ahead of ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, in that case, let's go down to the lobby and have some tea together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whew... That tea really hit the spot!
Taking a break was the right call! I feel so refreshed now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess it really is important to quit while you're ahead.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Definitely!
We haven't had much downtime lately since we've been practicing nonstop!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, can you tell us more about what happened at the zoo?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I just told you the other day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The best stories never get old no matter how many times you hear them! I wanna hear something wholesome and heartwarming! So, you should tell us more about how much fun you had at the zoo!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to hear as well if that's alright.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean... There isn't much more left to say.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, I don't think they've heard about the shoebill yet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aren't shoebills those really big birds?
They had one? What happened?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Remember how we caught that armadillo with the help of the staff?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were actually able to do that because of a shoebill that Minori had become friends with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, friends?! What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Apparently, shoebills greet others by clattering their beaks really loudly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And he did that after spotting Minori, which startled the armadillo enough to stop him in his tracks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was when we caught him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, that's so cool how Minori got the shoebill to greet her like that! I wanna become friends with him too now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A lot of other things also happened.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Minori got pounced at by this one Pallas's cat, we got to feed the alpacas...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Pallas's cats? As in...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, those really fluffy cats. The way this one behaved was so interesting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After it spotted Minori, it hissed and lunged at the wall between it and her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so cool! I want it to do that to me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's apparently pretty lucky.
The other guests seemed a little jealous of her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all had so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did anything else happen?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We also saw a Tsushima leopard cat with her kittens. They were really popular, and everyone was taking pictures of them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, the servals and caracals in the Savannah Area.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, their ears were so much bigger than the ones you see on domestic cats. I thought that was cool. It really made them look like hunters...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't go to zoos very often, but this one ended up being a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww... When's it gonna be my turn to go to the zoo with you guys and get mixed into a bunch of trouble?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You want to get mixed into trouble...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, Shiho went over to the rabbit area.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of rabbits, I thought these apple slices would be a nice snack for today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, they're sliced to look like little bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Bunnies...? Wait, aren't these...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I tried my hand at making them look like those lop-eared rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Their ears are all drooped...
It must've been really hard to get them to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I needed a lot of extra peel to get that to work. As a result, I was only able to make three out of one apple...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
These are works of art!
But why'd you choose lop-eared rabbits?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because of how much fun Shiho had playing with those baby lop-eared rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hey, they don't need to hear that...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's that? Shiho, did you make some new bunny friends?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You should introduce us sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
Sure, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Haruka invited me sort of out of the blue...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I went considering how much we got to enjoy that zoo.)
